howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.baseSelection.heading: 1. Pick a base
howToPlay.baseSelection.body: Each player picks one region as their home base, in turn order.
howToPlay.landGrab.heading: 2. Land grab
howToPlay.landGrab.body: Everyone answers the same trivia question at once. The fastest correct answers claim the remaining regions on the map, until every region has an owner.
howToPlay.battle.heading: 3. Battle
howToPlay.battle.body: Take turns attacking a neighboring region: win a trivia duel to capture an ordinary region, or chip away at an enemy base's hit points across up to five questions to capture it and eliminate its owner.
howToPlay.winCondition.heading: 4. Win
howToPlay.winCondition.body: The last player left standing wins. If the round limit is reached first, whoever holds the most points wins.
